thread:
talia: quick follow-up from the late-night repeat pages. want owners and short timelines so this doesn't keep recurring.

talia: distilled actions (short):
- A) shrink fanout using percentile-based contributors (owner: ben)
- B) implement adaptive dedupe (burst-aware window) (owner: hiro)
- C) add a tiered paging policy + circuit-breaker for rapid-fire pages (owner: talia)
- D) update runbook and add suppressed_pages & dedupe_metrics to dashboard (owner: talia)

ben: i'll own A. idea: only fanout to hosts that contribute > 5th percentile of errors over 1h; drop low churn hosts. will prototype in staging.

hiro: i'll take B. plan: dedupe window = min(600s, 3 * recent_interarrival_median) so bursts get wider windows. will add config flag "adaptive_dedupe: true".

ben: staging snippet i'll test:```yaml
fanout_strategy: percentile
percentile_cutoff: 5
lookback: 1h
```

hiro: and dedupe config sample:```json
{"adaptive_dedupe": true, "min_window_s": 60, "max_window_s": 600}
```

talia: for C i'll add a circuit-breaker: if a rule pages >4 times in 15m, mute paging for that rule for 30m and escalate via ticket. will also make paging tiers: critical -> immediate, high -> notify then escalate.

ops-bot: created ticket ONCALL-1205: "reduce repeat pages - adaptive dedupe + percentile fanout" linked: https://jira.internal/ONCALL-1205

ben: timeline: prototype in staging today (1809994800), run two 1h experiments, post results here.

hiro: timeline: build adaptive_dedupe in feature branch, canary in eu-prod for 8h on 1809998400; auto-rollout to global if suppressed_pages increase & false_suppression_rate < 2%.

talia: I'll open the paging-policy PR and the runbook update after we see staging metrics. target to merge PR by 1809999000.

ben: will add dashboard panel: fanout_contrib_percentile and post screenshots.

hiro: adding dedupe_metrics panel and will hook to alerting for unexpected suppression.

ops-bot: /remind set to review ONCALL-1205 results on 1810084800

talia: thanks team. please flag blockers in this thread and tag @talia. :white_check_mark:
